rakeback.change: Remove all surface imperfections from the rake: no nicks, chips, dents, scratches, worn or rough patches on the neon-lime rake head and tines, and no cracks, knots or splintered spots on the wooden handle. The lime head becomes smooth and clean with crisp, even edges and clean cel-shaded highlights; the wooden handle keeps a gentle, smooth wood grain only. Keep the exact same shape, pose, number of tines, colours and outline weight.

weekly.change: Replace the brass keyhole lock plate on the front of the chest with a gold lock shaped as the Goated logo. The lock's OUTLINE IS the Goated logo silhouette from the second attached image, cast as solid bevelled gold metal: two angular ram-horn shapes (the left horn with a long stem running down, the right horn shorter), with NO backing plate of any kind (no rectangle, shield, trapezoid or round plate behind it). The two horns are joined only by a small round gold keyhole boss set in the gap between them near the bottom, with a dark keyhole in it. Viewed from the front, anyone should recognise the Goated logo by its outline alone. Keep it the same size and position as the current lock plate, mounted on the front where lid and body meet.
weekly.ref_roles: the second image is the official Goated logo; reproduce its silhouette exactly (proportions, angles and the gap between the two horns). The third image shows how Goated paints the logo as embossed gold metal.
